title: Equity method of Consolidation
author: BCG
content: We have a requirement where we need to write only into C#Elimination of Share of Profit from A#NetIncome and Same to be written to A#Investment in Equity Account.
solution_text: If the Consolidation Algorithm is Standard then the PCON=0 will ensure nothing gets as far as the C#Elimination stage. You could have a calculate pass which reads directly from the child entity's C#Translated data unit. Another way is to simply have a member formula or Allocation Journal on the Holding Company's base entity.
